title: Day 764: Defense Ministry Sends 1,000 More Troops to Sinaloa, Two-Day Total Reaches 1,300
detail: SEDENA confirmed a second wave of reinforcements on Tuesday, August 25 into Wednesday, August 26, 2026, sending roughly 1,000 additional Army personnel to Mazatlán on top of the 300 airlifted earlier the same day — a combined 1,300-troop surge announced under the National Public Security Strategy 2024-2030. The Security Secretariat said the deployment 'priorizan la prevención y la presencia operativa' (prioritizes prevention and operational presence) to expand coverage, contain crime, and reassure Sinaloan families, coordinating with federal, state and municipal authorities to help dismantle criminal cells and detain violence generators. Sinaloa now hosts the largest concentrated military footprint of any Mexican state, with cumulative federal personnel levels cited at over 14,000 amid the ongoing Chapitos–La Mayiza conflict.

media.caption: Mexican Army reinforcements continue arriving in Sinaloa, bringing the two-day total to 1,300 personnel, August 26, 2026

title: Day 764: Alleged Gunman in Influencer César Gastélum's On-Camera Killing Captured in Puebla
detail: Mexican federal investigators, working from intelligence developed by the National Intelligence Center, located and arrested Jesús Alberto Hidalgo Iribe, alias 'El Dron,' in Puebla state on August 26, 2026. Hidalgo is accused of being one of two gunmen who, on August 4, 2026, shot content creator César Daniel Nolazco Gastélum in the head outside a KFC on Culiacán's Boulevard Enrique Sánchez Alonso while he livestreamed on the platform Kick; his two companions escaped unharmed. Investigators have examined Gastélum's own social media posts, which allegedly referenced criminal organizations including 'MZ' (a reference to Ismael 'El Mayo' Zambada), as part of a possible motive. During the Puebla operation, three armed individuals confronted federal agents; one aggressor was killed in the ensuing exchange while Hidalgo and a second suspect, Jesús Daniel Cazares Medina, were detained. Agents seized three firearms, ammunition, drugs and a vehicle. Secretary of Security Omar García Harfuch confirmed the arrest, crediting SSPC intelligence work for the location. Gastélum's killing was part of a documented pattern of at least a dozen Culiacán social-media influencers killed since September 2024.

media.caption: Federal agents detain Jesús Alberto Hidalgo Iribe, 'El Dron,' in Puebla in connection with influencer César Gastélum's killing, August 26, 2026
